init_pose_model: create a PoseModel instance with a config and checkpoint to initialize the MMPose top-down model
get_poses2d: run 2D pose estimation on an image given bounding boxes and optionally refine detected bboxes
refine_bboxes: refine bounding boxes in pose results by tightening them around valid keypoints above a score threshold
draw_poses2d: build a visualization of 2D pose results with keypoints and bounding boxes saved to an image file
draw_projected_poses3d: create a visualization of projected 3D poses onto a 2D image with keypoints saved to disk
